Home.metaDescription: A considered foundation for your next project. React, Next.js, and a connected, type-safe application stack.
Home.intro: A thoughtful starting point for the ideas you want to ship. The essentials, already working together.
Home.stackDescription: The foundations are connected. Your next idea belongs on top.
Home.cached: Public stack information cached for one hour
Home.architecture: Room to grow. A place for everything.
Home.uiDescription: Shared components, accessible primitives, and one set of design tokens. Make it yours without starting over.
Home.contractsDescription: Define the shape of your data before the implementation. Browser-safe contracts connect both sides of your app.
Home.apiDescription: Business logic and data access have a home of their own. Build the product without coupling it to the page.

Playground.metaDescription: Try Prelude’s task workspace, explore its live MCP tools, and preview an interactive MCP App.
Playground.heading: A little room to experiment.
Playground.intro: Make a task, try an agent’s tool, and see how the pieces work together. These examples share the same demo data and are ready to make your own.
Playground.widgetHeading: The same tasks. A new place to work.
Playground.widgetTitle: Bring the task workspace to your agent.
Playground.widgetDescription: Connect an MCP Apps compatible client to this site’s <endpoint>/api/mcp</endpoint> endpoint, then run <tool>listTasks</tool> to open the interactive task widget. You can filter, create, edit, complete, and delete tasks from your client.
Playground.inspectorHelp: The local Inspector starts with the development server. Connect and run listTasks to preview the widget.
Playground.connectionHelp: Use this site’s full URL followed by /api/mcp when connecting your client. The Inspector preview is available during local development.

Animation.heading: Small details. More life.
Animation.motionTitle: Give a small change some movement.
Animation.motionDescription: Choose a position and watch the tile settle into place.
Animation.morphTitle: Let the icon tell the story.
Animation.morphDescription: Save an idea and see the bookmark become a confirmation.
Animation.footer: These previews reset on reload and follow your device’s reduced-motion setting.
